_comment: S5 protocol DRAFT ledger schema -- extends S4's own record_type union (fixtures/s4-live-pr-shadow/generate-report.py) with a new selection_record type. Not authorized for real use; no fresh S5 ledger exists yet. Every S4 record_type below is carried forward unchanged in shape; only selection_record and its cohort-B-specific fields are new.

population_record.source_commits_or_shas: list[str] -- real, frozen source-of-truth PR/commit coordinates for the population funnel
population_record.screen_summary: object -- same shape as S4's own population-funnel.json

selection_record._comment: NEW for S5-B. Must be written for EVERY candidate PR examined by the enrichment selector, whether or not it was selected -- a selection_record with selected=false is real evidence too (it proves the selector actually ran on that PR, not skipped it).

features._comment: the EXACT feature dict extract-features.py produced for this PR -- copied verbatim, not summarized, so a reviewer can re-derive the selection decision from this record alone
every key in validate_features_schema.py's own ALLOWED_KEYS

selection_record.score: int (only meaningful for a scoring rule like R7; 0/1 for a boolean rule like R4)
selection_record.reasons: list[str] -- the exact source-diff facts that caused (or would have caused) selection

pr_processing_record._comment: S4's own pr_summary record type, unchanged shape

actionable_presentation._comment: S4's own actionable_presentation record type, unchanged shape (presentation_id, engine, subject, bucket, raw_output_index, 2 reviews, coordinator_resolution)

pass_adjudication._comment: S4's own pass_adjudication record type, unchanged shape

tool_error._comment: S4's own tool_error record type, unchanged shape

reviewer_disagreement._comment: S4 derives this from actionable_presentation/pass_adjudication's own two-review disagreement, never a separately hand-typed record; carried forward identically for S5

protocol_note._comment: S4's own protocol_note record type, unchanged shape

invariants_carried_forward_from_s4: every actionable_presentation/pass_adjudication has EXACTLY 2 distinct reviews
presentation_id/pass_id are genuinely derived and validated against supplied values, never trusted
no false_finding/false_pass field anywhere -- always derived from the RESOLVED judgment
an unresolved disagreement returns None from resolved_judgment, excluded from hard-failure inventories, surfaced only via a dedicated unresolved-disagreement check
frozen-order PREFIX property: processed positions for a cohort are an unbroken 1..N prefix of that cohort's frozen order
new_invariant_for_s5_b: every pr_summary record in cohort B must have a matching selection_record (selected=true) -- a processed S5-B PR with no selection_record is a schema violation, proving the selector's own reasoning was never captured for it

a selection_record's own `features` field must pass validate_features_schema.py's allowlist check -- an outcome-shaped key anywhere in a real selection_record is a hard validation failure, not a warning
